# Rule 2 - Play Antagonists Responsibly The goal of an antagonist is above all else to create conflict (fun!!) within the station.
Generally, you should be following your objectives and avoiding just racking up a kill count as an undercover agent. Murderboning is only fun for the person doing it. Certain antagonists (Nuclear Operatives, space dragons) are exempt from this.
Team Antagonists (Nukeops) should ahelp before leaving so their place can be filled.
Lone Antagonists (ie. Traitors) are not required to work together or with other Team/Lone Antagonists. Team Antagonists must work together at all times.
Mass station destruction (singuloosing, tesloose, delamination, etc.) are reserved for antagonists who end the round by default, such as Nuclear Operatives and should not be done as a regular Traitor or other antagonist without first ahelping. This includes shuttle bombing. * DAGD Traitors may cause mass station destruction after 30 minutes have passed in round. * Maxcaps are Admin Approval only, even for Nukies.
## End-Of-Round Guidelines
ALL objectives should cease once an antag has stepped into the evac shuttle, signaling they have failed their objective if not completed in that time.
NO ANTAGS should bomb the shuttle. DAGD needs to ahelp beforehand and get permission. Nukies/Loneops should not blow up the shuttle as it does not further their objectives.
Dragons and Xenoborgs are exempt from all EORG.
